title: SDKS Labs: compact playground recipes for resilient retries and streaming (Next.js / FastAPI / Go / CLI)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a set of compact, workshop-friendly SDK example templates that demonstrate production patterns for retries, idempotency, streaming ergonomics, and lightweight server/cloud/CLI integrations across Next.js, FastAPI, and Go HTTP servers. The artifacts should be small (single-file or minimal multi-file), well-documented, and intended for a 60-90 minute developer workshop and as starter code for product teams.
acceptance_criteria: Three minimal example repos (Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP) plus a single-file CLI example demonstrating streaming and resumable output
Each example includes a README with setup steps, a short troubleshooting section, and a one-page ‘pattern notes’ describing when to use batching, KV caching, or optimistic streaming
Retry wrapper implemented in each language demonstrating exponential backoff with jitter, max attempts, and idempotency key support
Streaming examples include graceful abort/reconnect guidance and a test that verifies partial-token handling (integration smoke test)
CI for examples (GitHub Actions) runs lint + unit tests + a lightweight integration test against the local inference runtime docker image
Docs and in-repo snippets reviewed and approved by DevX and PM (sign-off via PR comments)
tasks: Draft example architecture and minimal file layout for all languages
Implement Next.js incremental streaming example (edge function + client streaming handler)
Implement FastAPI async SSE endpoint with backpressure-safe consumer and retry wrapper
Implement Go HTTP server showing batching and KV-prefetch example plus CLI example using the Go SDK
Write language-agnostic pattern notes: retries, idempotency, streaming ergonomics, and caveats
Add CI + lightweight integration tests and publish example READMEs
Collect feedback from internal workshop (DevX lead, PM, and one external partner) and iterate
